title: A planned bug that fixes a code pattern lists the pattern's other sites in the tree, so a sibling is fixed or filed before the start
goal: precheck, or the planning step of /kb-sprint, lists for a committed bug whose goal names a code expression (such as round(0.95 * n) as a p95 rank) the other places the tree holds it, so each is in the goal, filed as its own item or named as out of scope before the start (SP-e4fm2ovk: BG-v5f5tn5y fixed the freshness p95, its worker found the verdict p95 int(0.95 * n) and filed BG-pjtajc2m, the review found bench_core.stat_rows' round() p95 and parked BG-z4mcy4w4)

run:
import json, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
live = json.load(open("backlog.json"))
(tmp / "backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir": "items", "id_prefixes": live["id_prefixes"]}))
BL = str(Path("_tools/backlog.py").resolve())
def run(*a):
    return subprocess.run(a, cwd=tmp, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
def bl(*a):
    return run(sys.executable, BL, "--root", str(tmp), *a)
(tmp / "_tools").mkdir()
(tmp / "_tools" / "a.py").write_text("def p95(n):\n    return round(0.95 * n)\n")
(tmp / "_tools" / "b.py").write_text("def verdict(n):\n    return round(0.95 * n)\n")
run("git", "init", "-q")
run("git", "add", "-A")
run("git", "-c", "user.name=t", "-c", "user.email=t@example.com", "commit", "-q", "-m", "base")
bl("new", "sprint", "--title", "s", "--goal", "g")
sp = next((tmp / "items").glob("SP-*.json")).stem
repro = "python3 -c \"import sys;sys.exit(1)\""
p = bl("new", "bug", "--title", "p95", "--goal", "the p95 rank round(0.95 * n) in _tools/a.py is off by one", "--touch", "_tools/a.py", "--sprint", sp, "--severity", "S3", "--repro", repro)
assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr
out = bl("precheck", sp)
text = out.stdout + out.stderr
assert "_tools/b.py" in text, "precheck does not list the other site of round(0.95 * n) in the tree: " + text[-300:]
